templates.name: Turn something on while a cycle runs
templates.description:
Turns a light, switch or toggle helper on when a WashData cycle starts and off when it ends, also after a false start.

Needs WashData 0.5.9 or newer.
templates.summary: Turns a light, switch or toggle helper on when a WashData cycle starts and off when it ends, also after a false start.

inputs.name: Turn on while running
inputs.description: A light, switch or toggle helper.

templates.name: End a long dryer anti-crease phase
templates.description:
Ends the anti-crease tumbling some dryers keep up for hours: the set minutes after the program, it switches the plug off between two tumbles and, by default, back on. A new cycle cancels it.

Risk: it switches a relay while the dryer is plugged in. Use a plug rated for your dryer, at your own risk.

Needs WashData 0.5.9 or newer.

inputs.name: Dryer
inputs.description: The WashData device of the dryer.

inputs.name: Wait first
inputs.description: Minutes after the program finishes. The power is cut at the first tumble after that; if the dryer has stopped tumbling, nothing happens.

inputs.name: Low-power threshold
inputs.description: Cut only while the dryer draws less than this, between two tumbles. Gives up if that does not happen within 15 minutes.

inputs.name: Only turn back on when one of these is home
inputs.description: Leave empty to always turn the plug back on. If set and nobody is home, the plug stays off.

inputs.name: Plug switch
inputs.description: Leave empty to use the switch on the same device as WashData's power sensor.

inputs.name: Then run
inputs.description: Optional actions afterwards, for example a notification. The variable switched_back_on tells whether the plug was turned back on.
